name: Virender Kumar
headline: Senior Full Stack AI Developer
summary: Senior Full Stack AI Developer with 7+ years of experience designing, developing, and scaling cloud-native applications using Next.js, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS. Experienced in building Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and LangGraph-based agentic workflows. Skilled in developing scalable web applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, and AI-powered solutions. Expertise also includes SQL, Microservices, OpenSearch and Event-Driven Architecture, with practical knowledge of AWS, Docker, CI/CD and production deployments. Strong focus on clean code, performance, security, scalability and maintainability, with a passion for continuously learning and building impactful AI-powered products.

experience.title: Senior Full Stack AI Developer
highlights: Led the migration of Strapi CMS from v4 to v5, refactoring custom plugins, middleware, and database queries to improve backend response time by 30% and improve production memory efficiency.
Reduced annual infrastructure costs by more than $1,200 by replacing third-party dependencies with custom React hooks and reusable internal modules.
Developed automated, CRON-based data synchronization between Strapi CMS and HubSpot.
Optimized Vercel CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment failures by 50%.
Reduced backend API calls by 40% through Next.js Static Site Generation (SSG) and caching strategies.
Strengthened application security through HTTP security headers, API rate limiting, and bot mitigation.
Contributed to post-acquisition integration initiatives for Pi.ai (Inflection AI) within Microsoft's ecosystem, supporting technical transition, system compatibility, and integration stability.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
highlights: Developed secure eSign and eNACH modules for Tata Capital's SME Loan platform, enabling end-to-end digital loan processing. This reduced dependency on manual verification.
Architected the 'Sugam Loan' digital approval workflow, optimizing business logic and API orchestration to reduce loan approval turnaround time and improve the experience for SME applicants.
Reduced production defects by 50% through code refactoring, structured logging, and improved testing practices.
Designed a reusable, configurable workflow framework using component-driven architecture and configurable business rules, accelerating feature delivery across multiple loan products.
Developed full-stack applications using Angular, React, Node.js, AWS Lambda, and MongoDB.
